q1.q: Do I need accounting knowledge to use Mizan?
q1.a: No. Accounting entries are recorded automatically in the background, and numbers are shown in plain language. An accountant can review the full details whenever needed.

q2.q: Does Mizan support e-invoicing for the Egyptian Tax Authority?
q2.a: We are working on e-invoicing support and integration with the Tax Authority system, and we will announce it as soon as it is available.

q3.q: Can I add multiple users with different permissions?
q3.a: Yes. You can invite your team members and set each user's permissions, so everyone sees only what is relevant to them.

q4.q: Can I export my data and reports?
q4.a: Yes. You can export your data and reports as Excel or PDF at any time.

q5.q: How secure is my financial data?
q5.a: We take your data security seriously: connections are encrypted, access is controlled by permissions, and each company's data is kept separate from others.
